3 ὁ ('the') understand ἀστήρ ('star'). 7 Ζαμαραρι ('Zamarari'): Ζαμάραν ('Zamara') the codex has: * according to the Arabic word
* zammâra , that is tibia ('pipe') (for * mizmâr ,), which is read in our Arabic
codices of Apomasar , (Dyroff). 9 κυράτου τοῦ ('of the master') the codex has. 11 ἀραιόδους ('with widely spaced teeth') the Ambrosian codex has.
15 μετριάσματα ('jokes') from μετριάζειν ('to joke'), to joke. 21 κεράμου σκεῦος ('earthenware vessel'): that is * iggâna ,.

summary.headline: Gemini and Cancer Decan Imagery
summary.text: Descriptions of the second and third decans of Gemini and the first decan of Cancer, comparing figures and co-rising stars according to Ptolemy and Indian traditions. The imagery includes Apollo, a zamar player, armed and crowned men, animals, plants, musical instruments, and constellation parts, with apparatus discussing Apomasar, Teucer, Musa, and variant readings.
